name: grade-stable

finding.title: `merge_ranges` keeps touching ranges apart
finding.description: `start < merged[-1][1]` is false when a range starts exactly where the previous one ends, so `(1, 3)` and `(3, 5)` stay two ranges instead of merging into `(1, 5)`.

prDiff:
diff --git a/src/ranges.py b/src/ranges.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/ranges.py
+++ b/src/ranges.py
@@ -30,2 +30,10 @@
 
 def merge_ranges(ranges):
+    # Only the compaction job calls this, after recovering from a crash.
+    merged = []
+    for start, end in sorted(ranges):
+        if merged and start < merged[-1][1]:
+            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], max(end, merged[-1][1]))
+        else:
+            merged.append((start, end))
+    return merged
